# rpkbin

> Modular IC design, modeling, and verification toolkit (`0.3.0`) targeting Python >= 3.11 and Linux RHEL 8.8 offline workstations (plus PySide6 desktop `rpk-calc`).

## Agent Skill

- [rpkbin AI Skill](skills/rpkbin/SKILL.md): Concise routing guide and verified recipes across all 9 modules without reading source code.

## Core Libraries (`rpkbin.*`)

- [MapBV (`rpkbin.mapbv`)](docs/en/mapbv/README.md): Unsigned hardware bit-vector modeling (`var`, `const`, `concat`), closed MSB-first `bv[hi:lo]` slicing, and deferred `eval(ctx)` logic trees ([API Reference](docs/en/mapbv/reference.md)).
- [TablePack (`rpkbin.tablepack`)](docs/en/tablepack/README.md): Schema-driven binary `bytes` codec (`Schema`, `pack`, `unpack`, `iter_unpack`, `infer`, `explain`, `DecodeLimits`) supporting rows and columnar inputs ([API Reference](docs/en/tablepack/reference.md)).
- [JobCore (`rpkbin.jobcore`)](docs/en/jobcore/README.md): Standalone multi-worker process scheduler (`JobManager`, `Job`, `ProcessHandle`) with resource quotas, backfill/strict priority scheduling, guarded `control()` receipts, and process-tree cleanup ([API Reference](docs/en/jobcore/reference.md)).
- [Flow (`rpkbin.flow`)](docs/en/flow/README.md): Thread-safe streaming log parser, stateful analyzer, event automation, and `ViewSpec` projection engine (`Flow`, `FlowSession`, `Parser`, `Analyzer`, `Automation`) ([API Reference](docs/en/flow/reference.md)).
- [Wave (`rpkbin.wave`, `rpk-wave`)](docs/en/wave/README.md): Orchestrates `jobcore` and `flow` with live/static log ingestion (`FileSource`, `TailSource`, `ReanalysisSource`), SQLite `RunArchive` storage with NFS staging, `ArchivePolicy`, `prune_archives()`, and a loopback Web GUI ([Python API](docs/en/wave/reference/python.md), [CLI Reference](docs/en/wave/reference/cli.md)).
- [mcucc (`rpkbin.mcucc`, `rpk-mcucc`)](docs/en/mcucc/README.md): Compiles restricted Python (`CompileConfig`, `compile_source`, `compile_file`, stack parking, `borrow_msb0`/`nborrow_msb0`) into target assembly with `V1`–`V11` static checks and differential verification against `isasim` ([Target Spec](rpkbin/mcucc/doc/target.md), [Language Subset](rpkbin/mcucc/doc/language.md)).
- [isasim (`rpkbin.isasim`, `rpk-isasim`)](docs/en/isasim/README.md): Retargetable instruction simulator and two-pass assembler (`MCU`, `assemble`, `Assembly`, `Simulator`, `Snapshot`, `Device`, `mem_alias`, `helpers`) ([API Reference](docs/en/isasim/reference.md), [Scenarios](docs/en/isasim/scenarios.md)).

## Interactive Applications (`rpkbin.app.*`)

- [isasim_gui (`rpkbin.app.isasim_gui`, `rpk-isasim-gui`)](docs/en/app/isasim_gui/README.md): Local loopback visual debugger (`DebugSession`, `create_server`, `relocate_breakpoints`) with step-back history and breakpoints.
- [rpk-calc (`rpkbin.app.calc`, `rpk-calc`)](docs/en/calc/README.md): Engineering & APyTypes fixed-point (`fxp`, `fxpi`, `WorkspaceSession`) desktop calculator, IPython Studio workspace, and headless `--eval` CLI ([Architecture](docs/en/calc/architecture.md)).
